rx.LANG_RULE: ReactiveScript (`.rx`), a new language that compiles to Solid 2.0. Nothing about it is online. Read `docs/guide/async.md` first: one page on reading from and writing to a server. Its specification is in `docs/spec/` (the concrete syntax is `docs/spec/07-surface.md`; modules and imports are `docs/spec/09-modules.md`). `src/main.rx` must be the program's entry, `export default component App() { … }`; you may add `.rx` modules under `src/`. Import the backend from "./api": loaders with `import pure { … } from "./api"`, functions that write with `import { … } from "./api"`. The prelude gives `import pure { len, str, map, filter, sum, every, indexOf } from "./prelude"`. Give an element a test id with `data-testid="…"`.
rx.CHECKER: the ReactiveScript compiler's checker (`rxc check src/main.rx`)
